audibility.rule: as packages/strudel/audibility.json, each control in its lesson's loop (content/specs/A1.ts, A2.ts) at the value the lesson grades or plays; a `same` row is a silencer the Make must fail and is asserted NOT audible; tuning: the first partial within ±10 c in the asked-for octave at the pitches the track lessons play each new sound

lessons.claim: the ladder filter's drive on the bass
a crackle bed thickened
the morph table from saw to square
the Make's threshold: the bass at .distort(.5)
hook: the bass saturated at 1.5 and turned down to match
hook: the hats crushed to five bits
the Make's threshold: the riff at six bits
the Make's threshold: every fourth sample held
a saturation curve of your own: diode against the default
silencer: 16 bits is too fine to hear
silencer: .coarse(1) changes nothing
hook: the lead sings with .vib(5).vibmod(.25)
S4's target, .vib(5).vibmod(.3)
the pad through a phaser at 2 Hz
the pad's level dipping four times a bar
hook: the pad's cutoff swept at .5 Hz
silencer: .vibmod(0) is no vibrato
silencer: .lprate() on a line with no .lpf() does nothing
the Make's threshold: .fm(.5) on the sine riff
S4: the ratio 3.5 rings like a bell against ratio 1
S5: the supersaw pad narrow and wide
the pulse wave's width, named in the stretch's hint
five detuned saws against one
a narrow pulse against the square
silencer: FM does nothing on a recorded instrument
the break's slices reordered
the break stretched over two bars
the break played faster and higher
the pad compressed under the loop

bands.rule: the first bar of each proposed Wave 7 Band (packages/strudel/e2e/wave7-bands.ts) in C at the tempo its lessons play it (swing 160, neo-soul 76, 7/8 and 9/8 at 180 to the eighth, the rest 96): parts within 10 LU of each other; the mix between −32 and −14 LUFS, peak under 0 dBFS (offline, before the master limiter)

cpu.rule: JC4's longest piece (wave7-fixtures.ts jc4Ballad: 32 bars at 60 BPM, 128 s; brushes, two-feel upright, rootless Rhodes, a vibes melody): rendered offline faster than real time by the production prebake (the CPU headroom; the whole wall clock counted, setup included), then 8 s live at 8× its tempo: no underrun, no skipped or missing sound, no late event, no stall over 200 ms, no 300 ms under −50 dBFS

jazz.rule: ride at 160 BPM: on beats 2 and 4 the 25 ms after the swung 'and' (2/3 of the beat) carry 6 dB more than the 25 ms after the straight one, and the straight pattern the reverse; brushes (tap, slap, swish) and the ride each louder than −45 LUFS and within 15 LU of the ride; the upright's walk (band.swing-two-five in F, 200 BPM): each quarter's first 50 ms over the 50 ms before it; every voice of every voicing changes the chord by more than −12 dB when taken out (the gate of the sevenths in Wave 6) — a shell's root on the Rhodes, which doubles the Band's bass, is recorded only — four-note voicings of one sound within 4 LU, no clipping

rhythm.rule: band.funk-16 at 96 BPM in every flavour: each ghost snare (the 'a' of 2, the 'e' of 3, the 'a' of 4, velocity .35) carries more than −20 dB of everything else in its 60 ms and sits 6 dB or more under the backbeat; RC1's horn stabs, the clav and the muted guitar (cleangtr held a third of its 16th) within 10 LU of the funk kit; band.son-clave's clave, congas (toms) and bell each more than −20 dB of the percussion
